author: Emmaye
body: It would be really cool if in the tab, your prestige star would show up in front of your name (that is if you have achieved prestige), and also when in game, a prestige star shows up next to your username (ex. *EmeraldSword85 showing over your head as your IGN). I just thing this would be a cool idea other than players targeting others with prestige
